Web developer serving Katanga

For studios, creators and service brands: a distinctive portfolio and contact flow. Based in Jabalpur, I collaborate remotely on projects in Katanga and across Madhya Pradesh.

THE VISITOR'S QUESTION

What should the site make easier?

For creative work, visitors want to see the output and understand the context behind it. A strong project section shows what was made, why it mattered and how to enquire about similar work.

A visitor may arrive on this page from search, a referral or a shared link. Give them enough specific information to understand the service and make a decision without asking them to guess what comes next.

// Katangaconst website = { audience: 'studios, creators and service brands', focus: 'a distinctive portfolio and contact flow', nextStep: 'talk to Nitesh'};
A USEFUL STARTING PLAN

Build around the real task.

I would pair a memorable visual system with fast, readable pages. Project images and motion should support the story, while the contact route remains visible without interrupting browsing.

A creator’s site should give the work room to breathe without making every project look identical. One case study can show the challenge, selected design decisions and final link. A potential client also needs practical information: what kind of work is accepted, how an enquiry starts and where collaboration happens.

QUESTIONS / ANSWERED

Good questions deserve direct answers.

How many projects should a portfolio show?

A smaller set with useful context often works better than many unexplained thumbnails. Include live links and your role where those details are accurate.

Can you work with me if I am outside Jabalpur?

Yes. I am based in Jabalpur and can work remotely for projects in Madhya Pradesh and elsewhere. We would agree on calls, reviews and delivery in the project scope.

What should I send for a first conversation?

Send your current website if you have one, the service or product you offer, the audience you want to reach and the most important action you want visitors to take.
